high_level_description: stc brand style, a minimalist digital illustration of a security shield icon with a padlock.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A checkered background of alternating light and dark gray squares.

elements.desc: A shield icon drawn in a minimalist purple outline style, containing a simple line drawing of a locked padlock in the center.
Concentric circular patterns of red and white curved lines radiating outward around the shield, with red as shorter dashes and white as longer curved segments.
